pr_body:
The changes in #83339 didn't make it into 7.17.0 but the code contains
version constants as though it did. This causes the wire protocol to
freak out. This updates the version constants to reflect 7.17.1 - which
is the version that #83339 made it into.

Closes #83393

issue_context.title: [CI] MixedClusterClientYamlTestSuiteIT test {p0=search.aggregation/70_adjacency_matrix/Terms lookup} failing
issue_context.body:
The underlying reason for this failure and a couple others in the same test suite was that one node got killed when upgrading. The node failed to start because a serialisation error for `InternalRange` https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/fx4ulm463asji/console-log#L6392

It seems that the backport PR #83339 didn't make its way into v7.17.0. It was automatically tagged as `v7.17.1` and `git tag --contains 7f5623f464576e775cf341fc9fde4a9f2aa9ce15` shows no result.
